time::performance.label: measure time

time::date.label: know time
time::date.description: Allows the extension to know your time and access time-related utilities

ui::basic.label: change UI
ui::basic.description: Allows the extension to change the user interface of Kaede

ui::interactivity.label: change and add interactive UI
ui::interactivity.description: Allows the extension to change the user interface of Kaede and act on your interactions
